ITEM 1 | Corn cob pieces, two rounds about 4 cm across and 2.5 cm thick, bright yellow kernels with pale cream centers, cut crosswise, slightly glossy, sitting at the upper right and right edge of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Sliced meat pieces, about 6 to 8 cm long and 1 to 1.5 cm thick, brown to dark mahogany edges with lighter pinkish-tan centers, seared and browned surfaces with a slight sheen, firm and slightly fibrous, arranged in a loose cluster on the left-center of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Cooked vegetable pieces, pale yellow-green and tan, about 4 to 5 cm long and 1 cm thick, limp and slightly translucent, with browned edges, mixed among the meat near the center | 35
ITEM 4 | Cubes of cheese or tofu-like pale white block, about 2 to 2.5 cm pieces, matte off-white surface, soft and slightly crumbly looking, one piece at the top center and one near the middle-right of the meat | 40
ITEM 5 | Fresh green leaves, dark to medium green with lighter veins, flat and glossy, about 8 to 10 cm across in a loose spread on the right side, partly underneath the tomatoes | 25
ITEM 6 | Cherry tomatoes, two halves or whole, about 2 to 2.5 cm across, glossy red to orange-red skin, smooth and taut, one whole tomato in the lower right of the leaves and one halved tomato near the top right | 30
ITEM 7 | Thin green strips, pale green and bright, about 3 to 4 cm long and under 0.5 cm wide, limp and moist, scattered among the meat near the lower left | 5
ITEM 8 | Dark brown glossy residue or light sauce film, thin and patchy, lying on the plate beneath the meat and leaves | 5
